_note: Magnetic Frequency. Key: archetype_key -> tier (dominant/present/subtle). Subtle is static.
subtle: This magnetic current runs quietly in your chart—present as a subtle energetic resonance, but not a dominant force in this portrait.
fallback: Your Magnetic Frequency highlights the unique way your presence is received by the world. While this specific signature is complex, it reveals an undeniable gravitational pull. Trust your natural resonance, allowing your authentic energy to draw exactly what you need toward you without having to force outcomes or manipulate the environment.

the_protagonist.dominant: As the Protagonist, your Magnetic Frequency operates through serendipity, plot armor, and an uncanny ability to bend the universe in your favor. You do not just move through the world; the world actively reshapes itself around you. Doors open, chance encounters alter your trajectory, and you naturally find yourself at the center of the narrative. The shadow of this archetype is the exhausting pressure to constantly drive the plot. You may feel like you are never allowed to simply exist off-stage, believing that if you stop performing, the story ends. Your growth edge is claiming your right to rest. You must remember that you are inherently magnetic even when you are doing absolutely nothing. You do not have to entertain the universe for it to support you.
the_protagonist.present: Operating as the Protagonist, your magnetism manifests as profound serendipity and natural plot armor. The universe seems to naturally bend in your favor, bringing you the right people and opportunities exactly when you need them. Your challenge is to trust this effortless flow, remembering that you do not constantly have to perform or drive the narrative to be worthy of the magic.
the_protagonist.fallback: As the Protagonist, your chart reveals a brilliant, serendipitous magnetism. You naturally attract favorable plot twists and unexpected opportunities simply by being yourself. Trust your undeniable ability to move through the world with grace, allowing the universe to seamlessly align the narrative in your favor.

the_scene-stealer.dominant: As the Scene-Stealer, your Magnetic Frequency is characterized by an undeniably loud, radiant, and commanding presence. When you enter a space, the energetic center of gravity immediately shifts toward you. You possess a brilliant, captivating aura that demands to be witnessed. The shadow of this archetype is the unintended consequence of outshining others. Because your light is so naturally bright, you can inadvertently cast shadows over those you love, or attract energetic vampires who want to siphon your radiance rather than celebrate it. In practice, you are the focal point, the star, and the spark. Your growth edge is learning the art of the dimmer switch. True magnetic mastery is knowing exactly when to blaze at full capacity, and when to soften your light to let others shine.
the_scene-stealer.present: You carry the signature of the Scene-Stealer, granting you an undeniably radiant and commanding presence. You naturally draw the energetic focus of any room you enter, shining with a captivating brilliance. The invitation here is to master the intentional use of your light—knowing when to blaze fully, and when to gracefully share the stage with those around you.
the_scene-stealer.fallback: As the Scene-Stealer, your presence is naturally radiant and deeply captivating. You effortlessly command the energy of your environment, drawing attention and opportunity through your sheer brilliance. Trust your inherent right to shine, using your powerful magnetism to illuminate the world around you.

the_siren.dominant: As the Siren, your Magnetic Frequency operates entirely through allure, gravitational pull, and profound mystery. Your magnetism is not loud; it is an undercurrent. You do not need to chase what you desire, because your authentic presence naturally compels it to come to you. You are deeply mesmerizing. The shadow of this archetype is the heavy weight of other people's projections. Because your energy is so captivating and mysterious, people will often fall in love with the idea of you, projecting their own fantasies onto your blank canvas rather than seeing the real, complex human underneath. Your growth edge is establishing fierce, unapologetic boundaries. You must learn to ruthlessly filter out those who are intoxicated by your frequency but incapable of holding your reality.
the_siren.present: Operating as the Siren, your magnetism is rooted in a quiet, profound allure and gravitational pull. You naturally draw what you need toward you without needing to chase it. Your challenge is to navigate the projections of others, setting fierce boundaries to ensure you are surrounded by those who love your authentic self, not just the mesmerizing idea of you.
the_siren.fallback: As the Siren, your chart reveals a deep, gravitational allure. Your magnetism is quiet but undeniably powerful, naturally drawing people, opportunities, and resources into your orbit. Trust your mesmerizing presence, allowing your authentic energy to effortlessly attract exactly what is meant for you.

the_luminous.dominant: As the Luminous, your Magnetic Frequency is a soft, ambient glow that provides profound warmth to those around you. Your presence is deeply comforting, healing, and inherently inviting. People are naturally drawn to you because your energy feels like a safe harbor; you make them feel seen and held simply by existing in the same room. The shadow of this archetype is becoming an energetic battery for the collective. Because you are so naturally warm and giving, you can easily become depleted, constantly radiating your light outward until you are entirely burned out. In practice, you are the lighthouse and the sanctuary. Your growth edge is learning how to charge your own battery. You must establish sanctuaries for yourself where you are not required to provide light for anyone else.
the_luminous.present: You carry the signature of the Luminous, meaning your magnetism manifests as a soft, comforting, and deeply healing ambient glow. People are naturally drawn to the warmth and safety of your presence. The invitation is to fiercely protect your own energy reserves, ensuring you do not burn yourself out by endlessly functioning as an energetic battery for everyone else.
the_luminous.fallback: As the Luminous, your presence offers a profound, comforting warmth to the world. You possess a soft but deeply powerful magnetism that naturally draws people toward your healing energy. Trust your ability to be a sanctuary for others, while always remembering to prioritize and protect your own radiant light.

the_magnetic_field.dominant: As the Magnetic Field, your frequency is a rare, potent combination of both serendipitous plot-armor and deep gravitational allure. You operate as a complete energetic ecosystem. You simultaneously bend the narrative in your favor while effortlessly drawing exactly what you desire into your orbit. Your presence is both commanding and deeply mesmerizing. The shadow of this archetype is total overwhelming saturation. Because your dual magnetism is so powerful, you can attract too much, too fast—pulling in chaotic opportunities, intense relationships, and heavy demands on your time. In practice, you are a master manifestor. Your growth edge is the practice of radical, uncompromising discernment. When you can attract absolutely anything, your highest spiritual discipline becomes knowing exactly what to say 'no' to.
the_magnetic_field.present: Operating as the Magnetic Field, you possess a rare and potent combination of both serendipity and gravitational allure. You naturally bend the universe in your favor while effortlessly drawing what you desire into your orbit. Your challenge is to practice radical discernment, learning to carefully filter the massive influx of opportunities and attention that your powerful dual-frequency naturally attracts.
the_magnetic_field.fallback: As the Magnetic Field, your chart highlights an exceptionally powerful, combined magnetic frequency. You naturally attract both serendipitous opportunities and deep, meaningful connections. Trust your profound ability to shape your reality, using your unique, commanding allure to draw in exactly what serves your highest good.
